learning_outcomes.text: Understand the characteristics of tires and the tire-road surface interaction.
Understand and apply the fundamentals of longitudinal dynamics to vehicle design.
Understand the fundamentals of lateral and vertical dynamics in vehicles.
Understand the fundamentals of automobile vehicle safety.
Be able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

teaching_methods: Classroom presentation of concepts and problem-solving sessions
assessment_rules: For ordinary call continuous assessment, there will be two theoretical tests and two problem tests. To pass, a weighted average of 5 points out of 10 or more is required, and all evaluation tests must have been completed. Students who do not pass by continuous assessment may take the extraordinary call exam to improve their grade in specific parts. The extraordinary call exam will cover the entire syllabus and account for 100% of the final grade.
